title: Per-SU collector configuration
description: collectors/<su-slug>/config.yaml. Fifty-odd SU/SDs publish budgets as they please and no scraper generalizes across them; the plan assumes this layer stays messy. The automation that matters is DETECTION -- knowing a new budget exists -- more than retrieval. Manual acquisition for 52 entities is a few hours a year.

priority.description: Coverage order. The business plan's ranked warm list drives this -- backfill is sequenced by relationship value, never alphabetically.

sources.description: Where this SU publishes budget material. Checked weekly for liveness; dead links open an issue.

document_pattern.description: Prose description of what to look for, e.g. 'annual report PDF, budget section beginning around p. 30'. Read by a human, not a parser.

link_selector.description: CSS selector for candidate document links, when the page is stable enough to scrape.

method.description: Expect roughly a third to be automatable. Do not fight the rest.

detection.description: How a new budget is noticed. page_hash watches the source page for any change; link_scan looks for new document links matching the pattern.

notes.description: SU-specific extraction quirks. This field is where solo-operator knowledge stops living only in one head.

known_not_published.description: Fiscal years confirmed to have no published budget document, so the coverage dashboard can show grey (confirmed absent) rather than red (missing). A gap we have checked is different from a gap we have not.

contacts.description: Who to ask. Names only -- no emails or phone numbers in a public repo; those live outside it.
